part.text:
Fixed in `internal/builtin/provisioners/remote-exec/resource_provisioner.go:244` — the disconnect-watcher goroutine now waits on a derived `cmdCtx` that is canceled via `defer cancel()` when `runScripts` returns. This closes the SSH connection immediately after all commands finish (or early on `Stop`/cancellation), instead of holding it open for the lifetime of the provisioner graph node.

Verified: `remote-exec`, `file`, `local-exec`, `communicator`, and `communicator/ssh` test suites all pass (notably `TestProvisionerTimeout`, which asserts disconnect happens after command completion).
